# gi.io_utils.brgi_db_to_dfs { #bedrock_ge.gi.io_utils.brgi_db_to_dfs }

```python
gi.io_utils.brgi_db_to_dfs(brgi_db)
```

Converts a Bedrock GI (geospatial) database to a dictionary of DataFrames.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                             | Description                           | Default    |
|---------|--------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|------------|
| brgi_db | BedrockGIDatabase \| BedrockGIGeospatialDatabase | The Bedrock GI (geospatial) database. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                          | Description                                                                   |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict\[str, pd.DataFrame \| gpd.GeoDataFrame\] | A dictionary where the keys are the Bedrock GI table names and the values are |
|        | dict\[str, pd.DataFrame \| gpd.GeoDataFrame\] | the DataFrames that contain the data for each table.                          |
